question: Should this release remove the 37 shipped root skill identities and make Sherpa ONNX TTS an official ClawHub-only plugin before a complete upgrade migration and exact-head trust approval exist?
rationale: The lean-core direction is supported, but the timing and accepted compatibility and security contract are release-owner choices that code review cannot infer.

options.title: Land after migration and trust proof
options.body: Require complete doctor mappings, upgrade tests, exact-head dependency approval, and verified Sherpa package and artifact availability before merge.

options.title: Accept the deliberate break
options.body: Merge with an explicit release-owner decision that old skill references may stop working and support will rely on documented manual recovery.

options.title: Split and park the trim
options.body: Move independently useful Sherpa work to a narrow PR and leave bulk bundled-skill removal parked until its migration contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Land after migration and trust proof
recommendation.body: Require complete doctor mappings, upgrade tests, exact-head dependency approval, and verified Sherpa package and artifact availability before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored both merged split PRs and has the strongest recent context for the remaining broad release surface.
